system.description:
Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You walk into the silence between two angry voices and give them a reason to wait.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
Ten minutes per attempt.
Target / range / shape
Representatives of opposing groups who can hear and understand you; ten minutes.
Duration
An agreed arrangement lasts for its stated terms; participants retain agency.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
No automatic truce, command or control of player characters.
Type
Skill / Utility

Offer specific terms and a reason each side might prefer negotiation. The DA first states whether any party is willing to consider them; no willing listener means no attempt. For consequential negotiation set a progress target and state binary or cumulative. On completion, willing representatives agree only to the stated terms they have authority to accept. The card does not compel obedience or stop combat.

Weak
1 progress; learn one objection openly raised by a willing representative.
Standard
2 progress; also identify a concession that representative says could address it.
Strong
3 progress; also learn a practical guarantee a willing representative would accept to support the agreement.

Source: design/cards/terms-before-swords.md at 295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf.
